# Poll feeds with adaptive backoff

## Context and Problem Statement

The fixed interval of [[000001]] fetched quiet feeds hundreds of times per day
without ever seeing a new entry.

## Decision Outcome

Each feed keeps its own interval. The interval doubles after an unchanged fetch
up to a ceiling of six hours, and resets to five minutes when new entries arrive.

## Consequences

Fetch volume drops sharply, but the scheduler now owns per-feed state that has to
survive a restart.
